Pass server icons through every builder (icons=) (#22)

FastMCP takes icons= at construction only (its icons property has no setter),
so a caller that wants a server icon in serverInfo had to bypass py2mcp and
build FastMCP itself. mk_mcp_server, mk_mcp_from_refs, mk_mcp_from_store,
mk_http_app and serve_http now accept icons= (an Icon, a dict of its fields, a
src string, or a list of them), forwarded only when given.

Needed by i2mint/enlace_connector#3.
